stimulus.source_note: Paraphrase of a Nahua account in the Florentine Codex (16th century), public domain; compiled by Bernardino de Sahagun with Nahua scholars.
stimulus.text: Paraphrase of a Nahua account of smallpox in Tenochtitlan, recorded in the Florentine Codex, compiled by the Franciscan friar Bernardino de Sahagun with Nahua scholars in the 1500s. The account describes the sick lying in their houses and sleeping places, no longer able to move or stir, while the healthy could not bury the dead fast enough. Whole neighborhoods fell ill at once.

parts.prompt: Identify one feature of the epidemic described in the account.
Explain how the epidemic described in the account helped Spanish conquest.
Explain one limitation of using this account as evidence about the epidemic.

instruction: Answer each part in your own words from the stimulus only. Do not open the question file.
